name: Depanneur Artisanal
description: Dernier Survivant de la Grande Panne ayant résisté aux pires conditions de la Ceinture incarnant la résilience absolue de son peuple.

subject.archetype: Depanneur Artisanal — Ferrailleurs de la Ceinture Legendary class radiation

loadout.armor_outfit: Heavy patchwork armor from salvaged hull plates with visible bolt patterns and rough weld seams, exposed hydraulic assist mechanisms leaking fluid from combat damage, thick reinforced gloves stained with oil grease and burn marks, protective welding mask pushed up on forehead revealing determined face with legendary cosmic materials and ancient craftsmanship that has become one with the wearer's being
loadout.arsenal: Modified industrial welding torch converted into combat flamethrower with extended flame range, multi-function cutting tool integrated into gauntlet for both welding armor and severing limbs, improvised explosive charges rigged from salvaged missile parts creating unpredictable devastating blasts The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's growing ability targeting adjacent_enemy, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Predatory lunge forward with hand extended like claw toward enemy with powerful significant red energy tendrils erupting from fingertips burrowing into enemy to siphon their strength
attitude.emotion: Transcendent purpose — no longer merely fighting but reshaping the battlefield itself with every movement and breath

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Rusted Orange-Brown
palette_names.role: primary_accent — salvaged metal surfaces and explosion fireballs

palette_names.name: Welding Arc Blue
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — cutting sparks and work light

palette_names.name: Oil Black
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — deep shadowed recesses and grease stains

color_and_light.lighting_setup: aurum-plated frame with living energy flowing through ornate faction-specific patterns, border radiates golden glow, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Cinematic ultra-wide angle with dramatic depth layers — foreground devastation, character as glowing focal point, background cataclysm, sky and environment permanently altered

scenography.setting: Active scrapyard warfare zone inside hollowed asteroid with massive spacecraft structures collapsing under fire sending debris raining down, molten metal cascading from ruptured tanks creating burning rivers, grinding sparks filling air from improvised weapons clashing against enemy armor, hastily built barricades buckling under assault, low-gravity making every debris float after breaking free
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Visible power drain with red tendrils burrowing into enemy and flowing stolen energy back to caster, enemy position visibly weakening and dimming as power is stolen and converted, Ground between caster and enemy withering as parasitic energy transfer corrupts everything in path, siphoned energy creating visible trail of corruption on return to caster, Welding torch flame erupting as flamethrower showering bright orange sparks everywhere, heavy metal plates buckling and flying from explosions creating shrapnel, grinding sparks fountaining from metal-on-metal impact, massive machinery parts falling in dramatic slow motion, hydraulic fluid spraying from ruptured lines creating oil slicks, molten metal dripping creating burning rain
